name: bb10-volte
scope: All 16 catalog entries (15 officially documented suffixes plus unconfirmed SQW100-2) in Q10, Classic/Q20, Passport and P9983 admit Mobile 460-00/07, Unicom 460-01 and Telecom 460-11 regardless of evidence status or band estimates. Historical tested, untested, known-issue and unsuccessful results are shown separately. Root, OS3216, native ABI hashes, SIM identity, backup and recovery requirements remain. Includes integrated pairing, lifecycle, SMS-busy boot recovery and explicit-activation cellular-ON changes; r42/mobile43 hardware acceptance is not inferred from earlier tests.
